Theorem
[Huisken pinching (Theorem 35.37)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0325, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0326 1. ch35:35.37\group Alternative Stability Methods

If a closed simply-connected $n$-manifold, $n\ge 4$, has positive scalar curvature and irreducible curvature components satisfying \[ |V|^2+|W|^2<\delta _n|U|^2=\frac{2\delta _n}{n(n-1)}R^2, \] then volume-normalized Ricci flow converges to a unique constant-positive- curvature metric.
